problem: The packaged Windows connector can only be replaced by copying a local file; operators cannot detect a published update package and apply it with one command.
non_goals: Do not add server deploy.sh, OWNER web update buttons, or Docker image publishing.
Do not add a new authentication source, token store, or TLS bypass.
Do not change pairing, submit, status, or retry behavior.

attackers: network attacker supplying a substitute download

historical_debts.rationale: cli.py gains an update command; pairing exactly-once markers stay unchanged.

success_criteria.description: superboss --check-update reports a newer GitHub Release without downloading.
superboss --update downloads superboss.exe, verifies SHA-256, and replaces the packaged executable.
Downloads refuse non-HTTPS or non-GitHub hosts, missing assets, and digest mismatches.

stop_conditions: No unresolved Critical or Important finding remains.
